title: OL-20261117-2: SPINOFF archetypes: template-generator and status-board
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** portfolio has fewer than 2 launchable archetypes
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/spinoff.json::template-generator
**Status:** open

Only domain-check is implemented, so the portfolio can launch one app. Build template-generator and status-board in spinoffs/worker.js with per-archetype checks, tests and metric sets; feasibility in doctrine/spinoff.json rises from 0.3 when each passes its tests.
